CATB.Settings.autoMood.Name: Automatic Mood
CATB.Settings.autoMood.Hint: Seen rolls, temptations, messes and finding the prize move the Broom and Cuddle meters (never past full; a temptation given in to never fills one), and a full meter fires Shoo! or Scooped!. Confirm: each change waits for the Storyteller's click in the Robbery Tracker. By hand: nothing is written; the Storyteller uses the meters' +1/−1.
CATB.Settings.autoSeen.Name: Fill in who sees a roll
CATB.Settings.autoSeen.Hint: The roll dialog fills in Seen, the watching human's Attention and kids from the robbery. Off: the roller ticks them by hand.
CATB.Settings.autoEffects.Name: Rolls change the house
CATB.Settings.autoEffects.Hint: A roll's result does what it says: a step done, a door open, a cat in or out, a dog driven off, a human Distracted. Off: the roll still counts for the Mood and noise; the Storyteller moves things by hand.
CATB.Settings.autoHouseTurn.Name: The house's turn
CATB.Settings.autoHouseTurn.Hint: End round runs the house's turn (pets, noise, routines, holders, Finding it) with the dice rolled in the open. Ask first, run at once, or by hand (End round only ends the round).
CATB.Settings.autoRoutines.Name: Roll routines
CATB.Settings.autoRoutines.Hint: The house's turn rolls every human's and pet's d6 routine and moves them (Searching humans hunt). Off: the Storyteller moves them by hand.
CATB.Settings.autoTemptation.Name: Temptation
CATB.Settings.autoTemptation.Hint: At Begin round, whisper the Storyteller who can be tempted with one-click buttons; or tempt a random eligible cat at once; or no prompt (the tracker still lists them).
CATB.Settings.autoCattitude.Name: Spend and earn Cattitude
CATB.Settings.autoCattitude.Hint: Pushes, resisting, giving in and Purrfects change the cat's Cattitude, and a robbery resets it (2, or 3 in a gang of three, plus the gang's Rep bonus). Off: the cards say what to change; nobody's sheet is touched.
CATB.Settings.autoPrizeClock.Name: Run the Prize Clock
CATB.Settings.autoPrizeClock.Hint: Begin round puts the prize down, moves it and takes it away as the house's Prize Clock says. Off: the Storyteller does it by hand.
CATB.Settings.autoOutcome.Name: End the robbery by itself
CATB.Settings.autoOutcome.Hint: At Lights Out, or at the end of a round when no free cat is left inside and the prize is out, eaten or gone, the house part ends and the getaway starts; when everyone is home or pinched the outcome is posted: Clean Getaway, Messy or Busted (with the campaign's Rep and Lives buttons). Off: the Storyteller ends it from the tracker; no outcome card.
CATB.Settings.autoGetaway.Name: Run the getaway
CATB.Settings.autoGetaway.Hint: After the house, the gang legs it over four obstacles with the loot (Chapter 9): getaway rolls move the cats, a Flop drops loot, the warden comes on at the end of each getaway round and corners the stragglers, and the loot that gets home is counted. Off: the tracker still shows the route, but the Storyteller moves the cats, the loot and the warden by hand.
CATB.Settings.autoCred.Name: Score Cred
CATB.Settings.autoCred.Hint: Showing off scores by itself (Chapter 9): tagging a room, getting into the catnip, leading the gang past the rivals and a getaway Purrfect; a cat with the zoomies gets +1 die, every roll it makes is a noise, it can't resist a temptation and its Cred counts double; the outcome names the Cat's Whiskers. Off: tags and the catnip are still noted, but the Storyteller keeps Cred and the zoomies by hand on the tracker.
CATB.Settings.trackerForPlayers.Name: Players can open the tracker
CATB.Settings.trackerForPlayers.Hint: Players see the Robbery Tracker (the house, the meters, the clock) with buttons for their own cats. Off: only the Storyteller opens it.
